product: NASA SRTMGL30 v002 (LP DAAC), 30 yay saniyesi (~1 km)
coverage: 90°N–60°S (Antarctic tiles are not in the product)
layout: row-major, north to south, eastward from -180; arrays in order: elev int16 (m, none=-32768), relief uint16 (m), s50 uint16 (0.1°), s90 uint16 (0.1°), valid uint8 (%); uint16 none=65535
method: cell = 30×30 pixels; slope Horn 3×3 (1 km); sea is coded 0 m in the product: 0 and -9999 pixels are excluded (coastal land at sea level may also be excluded); no value if land is under 10%
note: 1 km slope is not compared with 30 m window slope; not part of terrain distance
